answer: Each epoch, every identity renews its standing in a yarrow ceremony: it signs the new epoch seed with its expiring key, completes a fresh sequential proof-of-work bound to the replacement key, and publishes both signatures so anyone can verify continuity. A Sybil farm must run this ceremony for every fake identity each epoch, paying real wall-clock compute per identity, while the pearl of genuine standing, the unbroken chain of past ceremonies, cannot be copied or bought. Any identity that misses a ceremony is permanently void, its pigment-stained bond burned, and it must restart from zero.
